_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / shared-state-read-write. The model reads the UI's preferences and notes through the built-in `get_shared_state` and writes notes with the `set_notes` server tool (src/agents/shared_state.py).
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: google-antigravity staging: the Antigravity Go harness owns the conversation history and never sends role:"tool" messages, so hasToolResult/toolCallId never fire and every leg is staged on turnIndex (aimock's count of assistant messages; +2 per tool round-trip, +1 per text answer). The highest turnIndex <= assistantCount wins, so each leg carries every absolute position a test reaches it from: a fresh thread (0/2...) AND its slot in the probe's single-thread sequence.

fixtures._comment: Turn 1 of d5-shared-state.ts (feature shared-state-write; one thread: this turn, then the recall). Three legs: the silent built-in `get_shared_state` read (to see the existing notes), `set_notes` with the full list (set_state streams a STATE_SNAPSHOT the Agent Scratch Pad renders), then the answer. The probe asserts it mentions color or blue.

match.userMessage: remember that my favorite color is blue
remember that my favorite color is blue
remember that my favorite color is blue

response.content: Got it — I noted that your favorite color is blue.

fixtures._comment: Recall on a fresh thread. The full prompt is the match key: the bare "favorite color" key langgraph-python uses is a substring of the turn-1 prompt and would compete with its legs.

response.content: Your favorite color is blue — it's in my notes.

fixtures._comment: Turn 2 of d5-shared-state.ts: turn 1 left the thread at assistantCount 5 (two tool round-trips + answer). The probe asserts the answer contains "blue".

response.content: Your favorite color is blue — it's in my notes.

fixtures._comment: 'Greet me' pill. shared-state-read-write.spec.ts expects /shared-state co-pilot/ and not the generic showcase blurb.

response.content: Hi — I'm your shared-state co-pilot. I read your Preferences panel (name, tone, language, interests) from shared state before every answer, and I jot notes back into the Agent Scratch Pad via set_notes so the UI re-renders. Try setting your name or asking me to remember something.

match.userMessage: Remember that I prefer morning meetings and that I don't eat dairy.
Remember that I prefer morning meetings and that I don't eat dairy.
Remember that I prefer morning meetings and that I don't eat dairy.

response.content: Noted — you prefer morning meetings and you don't eat dairy. Both are in the scratch pad now.

fixtures._comment: 'Plan a weekend' pill. shared-state-read-write.spec.ts expects /interests panel/.

match.userMessage: Suggest a weekend plan based on my interests.
Suggest a weekend plan based on my interests.

response.content: A weekend tailored to your interests panel: if you haven't picked any yet, try Cooking + Travel for a market-and-day-trip combo, or Tech + Books for a maker session and a long reading afternoon. Add interests in the Preferences panel and re-ask for a more specific plan.
